items.title: Michi Fuji interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: Junior and I listen a lot to B.B. King.

ctx.x: Just listening. Junior and I listen a lot to B.B. King. But yeah, just listening. But sometimes I transcribe somebody’s blues and learn, but mostly listening.
How do you make a violin swing?
